title: Canonical DecisionRecord
description: PROPOSED append-only accept/reject/cancel record. PROPOSED hashing rule: remove record_sha256, serialize the remaining object with JCS (RFC 8785), UTF-8 encode it, and compute SHA-256. The resulting complete JSON, including record_sha256, must be byte-equivalent in MR note and protected annotated tag. JCS support is a proposed implementation contract, not a verified GitLab capability.

decision_id.description: UUID and decision idempotency key. The HTTP Idempotency-Key for a decision command must equal this value.

payload_hash.description: SHA-256 of the normalized decision command payload used by actor+route+payload idempotency binding.

record_sha256.description: SHA-256 of canonical JCS bytes for this object with record_sha256 omitted.

supersedes_decision_id.description: Correction creates a new decision_id and never edits the superseded JSON.

x-contract-invariants.rule: accepted/rejected/cancelled are canonical actions. Operational command mapping is accept/reject/cancel respectively; rejected and cancelled close the MR without merge and remain recorded outcomes, never aliases of merged, failed, conflicted, or invalid.
decision_record.base_sha and proposal_sha equal the reviewed ProposalVersion base_sha and proposal_sha for the same proposal_id, repository_id, space_id, and target_branch.

A replay of the same decision_id and identical command returns the single current Git-derived outcome without creating an attempt or other side effect. Only the guarded recovery coordinator may create a new attempt under the same decision after conclusive failed, completed request, and proven no-merge evidence.
